patterns.label: Kinetic Type
patterns.description: Scale, translate and settle the target with rhythmic typographic emphasis.

patterns.label: Flat Shape Motion
patterns.description: Geometric shapes travel around the target and resolve into the final composition.

patterns.label: Info Motion
patterns.description: Data-oriented reveal that pairs semantic count or chart growth with restrained emphasis.

patterns.label: UI Motion
patterns.description: Panel-like target slides and settles with interface-style focus treatment.

patterns.label: 3D Card Stack
patterns.description: Layered cards create depth before resolving to the target plane.

patterns.label: Particle Warp
patterns.description: Deterministic particles converge toward the target and disperse.

patterns.label: Glitch
patterns.description: Short RGB displacement and jitter burst around the semantic beat.

patterns.label: Liquid Morph
patterns.description: Soft blob forms morph behind the target during the cue.

patterns.label: Isometric Build
patterns.description: Target rotates from an isometric plane into its final readable state.

patterns.label: Paper Cut
patterns.description: Layered paper-like slabs assemble behind the target.

patterns.label: Type Mask
patterns.description: Target content is revealed through a directional clipping mask.

patterns.label: Environment Type
patterns.description: Perspective and depth motion make the target feel embedded in a spatial scene.

patterns.label: Occlusion
patterns.description: A foreground occluder crosses the target to create a depth-aware reveal.

patterns.label: Scramble Decode
patterns.description: Target resolves from a coded/noisy visual state into the accepted final frame.

patterns.label: Variable Font
patterns.description: Weight and width axes animate toward the final typographic state.

patterns.label: Swiss Grid
patterns.description: Grid guides and modular offsets resolve into a disciplined final layout.

patterns.label: Extruded Type
patterns.description: Layered shadows create a temporary extruded text/depth treatment.

patterns.label: Street Collage
patterns.description: Rotated strips and tape-like layers assemble around the target.

patterns.label: Path Drawing
patterns.description: An SVG path traces around the target and resolves into the final state.
